label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.4 a.2… supports Every pure perfection is a perfection of…
note: ST I q.4 a.2 says the perfections of all things pertain to the perfection of being. The encoded statement restricts this to pure perfections, a weaker reading. It does not supply ad 3's distinction between participation in being and in every mode, or any causal transfer.
